project_type: Monorepo streaming platform - React SPA (web) + React Native/Expo (mobile)
build_system: Bun workspaces. Root package.json delegates to apps/web and apps/mobile. Vite for web build, Expo for mobile.
test_framework: Vitest for web (tests/api.test.js, tests/transform.test.js). No mobile tests.
build_command: cd apps/web && bun install && bun run build
verification_instructions: 1. cd apps/web && bun install 2. bun run lint (0 errors, 0 warnings) 3. bun run typecheck (0 errors) 4. bun run build (successful vite build) 5. bun run test (all tests pass) 6. cd apps/mobile && bun install && bun run lint (0 errors)
setup_instructions: 1. cd apps/web && bun install 2. cd apps/mobile && bun install
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. node_modules not pre-installed.
contribution_requirements: ESLint flat config (eslint 9), no prop-types required, unused vars must be prefixed with underscore. jsconfig.json with @/ alias. Must pass lint, typecheck, build, test with 0 errors 0 warnings.
key_patterns: Web: React Router v6 with lazy loading, TanStack Query for data fetching, Tailwind CSS with custom colors in tailwind.config.js, vite.config.js has @/ alias. Mobile: Expo Router with file-based routing, tab navigation at (tabs)/, TVFocusable wrapper for all interactive elements, StyleSheet.create for all styles, same api.js pattern as web but async with AsyncStorage-backed cache. Both platforms share identical API endpoints and data shapes from TMDB. Colors: bg #0F0F0F, surface #1A1A1A, border #2E2E2E, primary #6366F1 (web) / #2563EB (mobile).
directory_structure: Root monorepo with apps/web (React SPA - Vite+Tailwind) and apps/mobile (React Native/Expo). Web: src/app/ for pages, src/components/ for shared components, src/hooks/, src/utils/. Mobile: src/app/ for Expo Router screens (file-based routing with (tabs)/ group), src/components/, src/utils/.
